item.title: A large immigration detention camp in Texas is closed to visitors amid measles outbreak
item.description: There are 14 active measles cases and 112 people are being isolated at the facility.

item.description: All were assigned to the 103rd Sustainment Command.

item.title: Fearing GOP upset, top California Democrat urges lagging candidates for governor to drop out of race
item.description: The all-GOP general election is possible under California's unusual top-two primary system.

item.title: Westford Academy girls ousted by fourth-seeded Andover, 55-43
item.description: ANDOVER — It was a classic case of a team with impressive size going against a smaller, more athletic team. After four quarters, athleticism won out. item.title: Votes cast on 1st Middlesex District state Senate post
item.description: Voter turnout was light on Tuesday in the election to fill the vacant 1st Middlesex District state Senate seat, but many people showed up to cast their ballots in hopes that their candidate would win.

item.title: The Five Minute Read: Riverbend welcomes new medical director
item.description: The Five Minute Read highlights things to do, places to go and people to know in the Greater Lowell area. Have news to share? Send it to news@lowellsun.com. Submissions must be received at least one week in advance to be considered for publication.

item.title: Colleges: UML men’s basketball team tops Maine, learns AE playoff opponent
item.description: The UMass Lowell men’s basketball team ended the regular season with a win and learned its playoff opponent Tuesday night. The River Hawks went on the road and defeated Maine, 67-56, thanks to a 33-point effort from junior Angel Montas Jr. in Orono. UML (14-17, 9-7 AE) will host Albany in an America East quarterfinal […]

item.title: Lowell High School students protest ICE deportations
item.description: A crowd of Lowell High School students participated in a school walkout on Tuesday afternoon, with many holding signs referring what they said was an overreach by U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement in deporting immigrants.

item.title: Vanna Howard wins state Senate race in unofficial results
item.description: LOWELL — State Rep. Vanna Howard has won the 1st Middlesex District state Senate election in unofficial results from the cities and towns in the district, over Republican candidate Sam Meas and unenrolled candidate Joe Espinola.
